mechanism_narrative: The observed upward trend in RETAIL_REC mobility over the last week, following a period of relative stability, indicates a sustained recovery in consumer activity that will continue to drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not show a mean increase compared to the last 28 days, or reverses its recent upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent increase in WORKPLACES mobility, nearing pre-baseline levels, suggests a critical mass of people returning to offices. Once WORKPLACES exceeds -10% from baseline, it will trigger a significant increase in nearby retail activity over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES mobility rises above -10% from baseline, but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the subsequent two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The combined trend of decreasing RESIDENTIAL mobility and increasing TRANSIT mobility signifies a population increasingly leaving homes and utilizing public transport. This interaction will lead to greater foot traffic in commercial areas, boosting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility continues to decrease while TRANSIT mobility increases, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the previous 28 days.

failure_condition: Despite the seasonal shift and increased PARKS mobility, RETAIL_REC does not show a sustained increase over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The recent uptick in GROCERY_PHARM mobility suggests a broader return to essential out-of-home activities. candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises by more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM mobility rises by more than 2 points week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC does not increase in the subsequent week.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous and sustained increases in both WORKPLACES and PARKS mobility indicate a dual recovery in both work-related commuting and leisure activities. This combined increase in out-of-home presence will drive a general uplift in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Both WORKPLACES and PARKS mobility continue to increase, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the previous 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Despite recent declines, if RESIDENTIAL mobility fails to drop below 7% in the upcoming week, it indicates a persistent reluctance among a segment of the population to fully engage in out-of-home activities, thereby limiting the potential for RETAIL_REC growth over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL mobility does not fall below 7% in the next week
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility does not fall below 7% in the next week, yet RETAIL_REC still increases over the subsequent two weeks.
